## Preferred route

Local containers are the default route for the workshop.

```bash
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/work -w /work IMAGE bash
podman run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/work -w /work IMAGE bash
```

## Windows

Use WSL2 Ubuntu plus Docker Desktop WSL2 integration. Keep project files in the WSL filesystem.

## Disk hygiene

Do not keep duplicate FASTQ, BAM, and temporary files. Never commit generated sequence files to Git.
